The same Actuator resumed under the public-domain-material amendment. The exact main base remains 73606d03f8416a9fdc50e1c6fbe301546a66a6c5; there is no open successor PR.

**Execution commit:** `db33138b7eb6336fe99b7f9260558fc9a8a6b6b0` on `preparation/borrowed-recurrence-20260922` (pushed).
**Package:** `experiments/borrowed-recurrence-feasibility-v1/`.
**Freeze SHA-256:** `d7b014b14f0ba8f60535f53c00bf017c13773790a6aff31db71a948239640c70` for `freeze.json`.

The freeze hashes protocol, all executable analysis/validation/listener/generator code, disjoint piece/motif split, exact source bytes and rights provenance, deterministic input manifest, independent labels/equivalences/query schedule, selected readout/thresholds, development results/validation and resource preflight. Model/checkpoint/config hashes and runtime/library versions are embedded in the freeze. Evaluation MIDI note content, PCM and derived measurements remain unexposed; exact rendered-input hashes will be recorded after the one authorized generation.

Development completed 32 sessions and 384 readouts with no repeated music session. The already-completed MERT qualification was reused. All independent software/provenance/access/eviction/evidence/preservation checks pass and the complete analyzer/report schema passed. The fixed development choice is MERT layer12, ten duration-weighted rows per completed second. Distance thresholds: standard .05, MERT12 .10, clean ceiling .00. Layer6 was the only other declared candidate; no new candidate will be added.

Both audio routes receive arrived PCM only, in one-second completed contexts; no phrase boundaries or score labels. Last-two-second observed query selection, bounded shift search, FIFO persistent policy (8MiB cap), four-second raw ring, full/recent/source-removal conditions, timestamp availability and sidecar access are explicit in `PROTOCOL.md`. MERT is labeled hybrid because sidecar chroma estimates shift. The clean-score child is isolated from the audio child. These are rendered isolated Bach figures and new compositions, not natural-performance or perceptual-identity claims.

The original acceptance thresholds, 5,000 paired family bootstrap seed2026092201, A/B/C/INVALID precedence and stop rules are unchanged. Development already exposes stretch-estimation failures in the clean ceiling; those settings remain fixed rather than being repaired. This is not a guarantee of a qualifying result.

`preflight.json` reserves all64 evaluation sessions /576 readouts: total1000 conservatively charged executions/probes including a40-probe preparation allowance; projected compute4168.1/7200 seconds and canonical artifacts686,711,311/2GiB. Source acquisition123,847/25MiB; spending$0. No capacity-pressure claim, model change, new training, added transformation, historical modification or follow-up experiment.

Proceeding to the single held-out comparison under the existing authorization. Afterward publish the complete successor as draft → label earworm-review-ready → ready, return exact publication head and result paths, then stop for the existing reviewer.
